what_this_is: Links a person saved somewhere else, kept in their own Trillion files, as Workshop tools that run inside that person's store (placement:this-account; src/saved-links.mjs through src/person-store.mjs accountActions): a browser's saved-items file handed in (Arc's pinned tabs, folders and favorites), and a connected service's list read page by page (X bookmarks; also read by Trillion on its schedule through events:x-bookmarks in workshop-event-source-records.json). The same two jobs are MCP tools in src/saved-links-tools.mjs (save_browser_saved_items, save_x_bookmarks).

payload.label: Save a browser's pinned tabs and folders to your files
payload.job: Save the links a person keeps in their browser (pinned tabs, folders and favorites in each pursuit) into their Trillion files, from the browser's own saved-items file
payload.description: Give file: the browser's saved-items file already in this person's files, by its identity (1f: then 64 hex) or its name. For Arc it is ~/Library/Application Support/Arc/StorableSidebar.json on their Mac; send it first with write_file or start_file_upload. format (optional) names the browser when it cannot be told from the file. Every group (an Arc space, and Favorites) is kept as one file under /Saved links, replacing that group's earlier file, as JSON: { saved_from, group, updated_at, links: [{ title, url, folder, saved_at }] }. Returns each group's file and how many links it holds. Tabs that are only open (Arc's Today) are not saved links and are left out.

file.description: The saved-items file's identity (1f: then 64 hex) or its name in the person's files

format.description: The browser, when the file does not say: arc-sidebar

payload.label: Save your X bookmarks to your files
payload.job: Save a person's X (Twitter) bookmarks into their Trillion files, all of them at once or only the ones made since the newest one already saved
payload.description: Reads the bookmarks of this person's connected X account, 100 at a time, through the X tools (tool:x-find_my_account, tool:x-list_bookmarks, tool:x-list_more_bookmarks), and keeps them in /Saved links/X - Bookmarks.json, newest first, without losing any already kept: { saved_from, group, updated_at, links: [{ key, url, title, author, author_name, posted_at, found_at }] }. Without since it saves every bookmark X hands out (X keeps the newest 800) and returns newest, the newest bookmark's id, and no items. With since (the newest id from the last read) it reads only until it meets that bookmark and returns the new ones in items; Trillion does this by itself on its schedule once X is connected (events:x-bookmarks), so each new bookmark also reaches the person's rules. Needs X connected on the Connections screen.

since.description: The newest bookmark id the last read returned; left out, every bookmark X hands out is saved

payload.label: Save the posts you liked on X to your files
payload.job: Save a person's X (Twitter) likes into their Trillion files, all of them at once or only the ones liked since the newest one already saved
payload.description: Reads the posts this person liked on their's connected X account, 100 at a time, through the X tools (tool:x-find_my_account, tool:x-list_likes, tool:x-list_more_likes), and keeps them in /Saved links/X - Likes.json, newest first, without losing any already kept: { saved_from, group, updated_at, links: [{ key, url, title, author, author_name, posted_at, found_at }] }. Without since it saves every like X hands out, 100 to a page, up to 3,200 and returns newest, the newest liked post's id, and no items. With since (the newest id from the last read) it reads only until it meets that post and returns the new ones in items; Trillion does this by itself on its schedule once X is connected (events:x-likes), so each new like also reaches the person's rules. Needs X connected on the Connections screen.

since.description: The newest liked post id the last read returned; left out, every like X hands out is saved
